name: Roronoa Zoro
title: Flood the board and buff your whole team with this speed-focused aggro deck!
desc: Activate Leader Zoro's effect to turn your 4000-power Characters into a serious threat to your opponent's Leader. Aim for a swift victory with this Leader by playing one low-cost Character card after another.
